From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call exec recap: Orion Retail - Next steps & procurement path

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick exec-level recap and the agreed next steps so we have alignment with your leadership and procurement teams. TL;DR: Redwood can meet Orion's latency and data isolation needs; main open items are procurement timeline and SLA details.

Summary of pain points and goals we discussed:
- High-throughput in-store inference during peak hours (latency target < 150ms P95)
- Data residency and auditability for cardholder and PII-related logs
- Predictable unit economics to hit FY27 margin targets for the retail analytics product

Business outcomes (what Orion gains):
- Consistent <150ms inference across 3 major regions to avoid checkout friction
- Audit trail for inference requests for compliance and chargebacks
- Estimated 30-40% per-token cost reduction vs current self-hosted stack through batching and KV caching

Open risks / escalations:
- Procurement needs an approved SOC2 + KMS/HSM attestation (we provided SOC2 Type II earlier; see attached SLA summary)
- Pricing approval needed from procurement by 03/19 to hit onboarding in April

Procurement path and timing:
- You mentioned procurement wants a single consolidated quote and SOW + legal redlines. Next step: we share a mutual action plan + draft SOW for their review by Monday 03/08.
- Procurement contact: Sabrina Lopez (cc'd) — she will confirm required PO terms and vendor onboarding checklist.

Action items (owner / ETA):
1) Sean: send mutual action plan + draft SOW and SLA summary (attached) — by 03/08
2) Michael: share procurement PO process & any mandatory contract clauses — by 03/12
3) Marissa: prepare pricing options (standard vs committed capacity) and recommended ramp plan — by 03/10

Attachments: redwood-sla-summary.pdf (overview), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (placeholder - will follow final)

Proposed next touch: 03/10, 10:00 AM PT — 15 minutes to align on pricing and procurement path. If that works I’ll send an invite.

Thanks — appreciate the time.

—
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Sean —

Perfect, thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with what I’ll present to our CTO and CFO. A couple quick clarifications:
- Latency target: we need the P95 number in a formal SLA table (can you include that in the SOW?)
- Data residency: we require logs to be stored in our AWS account with encryption keys we control (KMS). Is that supported for Private deployment?

Sabrina (procurement) — looping you in to confirm paperwork flow. We typically need a vendor questionnaire + signed SOW + PO. Can Redwood provide a standard template and an anticipated contract execution window (we aim for sign-off no later than 03/19 to enable April onboarding).

I’ll confirm availability for the 03/10 slot once I sync with the finance team.

Thanks,
Michael Chen

Pricing options to include in the MAP:
